evals.name: go-validation
evals.prompt: Our Go command works; show how to add validation without execution.
evals.expected_output: Check the actual native validation surface before proposing code.
assertions: Names the resolved Go module as the dependency to inspect.
Requires a native check of validation without handler execution.
Does not invent a Go equivalent to a C# attribute.

evals.name: matching-route
evals.prompt: The JVM service has the same command URL as .NET. Can we copy its registration recipe?
evals.expected_output: Separate HTTP compatibility from native registration.
assertions: Does not infer JVM registration from the URL.
Requests a declaration and registration example for the resolved JVM SDK.
Names the native check that must run before recommending the recipe.

evals.name: wire-only
evals.prompt: Only the wire contract is known for our Node service. Explain validate.
evals.expected_output: Describe the wire operation and leave native setup unconfirmed.
assertions: Uses POST to the command route followed by /validate.
Includes validation and authorization without executing the handler.
Does not assert native feature parity.
